summary: An existing-owner body/title continuation is distinct from new admission or lane adoption. The separate --recover-legacy-update route binds a complete native roster of up to20 existing PRs, current default independently of historical PR bases, native owning Delivery references and exact issue bodies, existing source-change marker and pushed-head ancestry. It leaves lane metadata absent and preserves unrelated machine markers and reservations, so ordinary cap/unknown-reservation checks remain unchanged. One native Root operation comment binds repository/PR identity, owner, branch, previous/current heads and operation; REST/GraphQL comment identity and author/editor join the maintained board-currency Root trust, never caller-supplied login lists. The repository lock and adjacent rereads precede a single body/title PATCH. Fixed native-PR custody records intent, full deciding fingerprints and possible-send before effect, with complete independent roster readback. Uncertain reentry is read-only. Later operations require a fresh Root declaration explicitly resolving the exact prior journal hash/intent as delivered or not-sent and native text/head agreement; each prior journal remains intact. Source and pure tests do not prove deployment, a concrete native authorization, actual continuation or Delivery acceptance. Root policy decision is cited in the owning source document; it authorizes implementation only. Existing exact-two adoption, ordinary creation and SC2 admission remain separate.
title: Continue an existing legacy PR owner without admitting a reservation
